title: Member Services Quick Reference: Prepaid Dental HMO Plans Primary Care Dentist Change Terms
content:
**Prepaid Dental HMO Plans — primary care dentist change terms by plan**

| Plan | Change cutoff day of the month | Changes allowed per benefit year | Change held while a multi-visit procedure is unfinished |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 | 20 | 4 | Yes |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 315 | 20 | 4 | Yes |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 415 | 20 | 6 | Yes |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 515 | 20 | 6 | Yes |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 | 20 | 12 | Yes |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 | 20 | 12 | Yes |

**What each column means**

- *Change cutoff day* — day of month; a primary care dentist change requested on or before this day takes effect on the first of the next month, later requests on the first of the month after.
- *Changes allowed per benefit year* — count of primary care dentist changes allowed per benefit year (changes forced by the dentist leaving the network do not count).
- *Held while a multi-visit procedure is unfinished* — true means a change is not processed while a multi-visit procedure (crown, bridge, denture, root canal) started by the current dentist is unfinished.

**The cutoff on the 20th, both sides (hypothetical dates)**

| Request date | On or before the 20th? | New dentist effective |
|---|---|---|
| 20 April | Yes | 1 May |
| 21 April | No | 1 June |
| 3 November | Yes | 1 December |
| 28 November | No | 1 January |

**Allowance by plan**

- 4 changes per benefit year on the DHMO 215 and 315; 6 on the DHMO 415 and 515; 12 on the DHMO 615 and 715.
- A change forced by the dentist leaving the network is not counted against these numbers. Hypothetical example: a DHMO 215 member with two member-requested changes and one change forced by a departing dentist in the benefit year has used 2 of the 4.
- Every plan holds a change while a crown, bridge, denture or root canal started by the current dentist is unfinished.
